title: Pulsatile flow through the cosine constriction (Varghese et al., Part 2)
headline: throat peak at peak flow −1.3 % from the DNS; the five flow features of its §3.1 as in the DNS

references.source: DNS, Part 2: axial velocity profiles at six phases, x/D -2 ... 15 (Purdue CFD Lab database, Axi_puls)

toolchain.conversion: gmshToFoam, with -keepOrientation when the worst scaled Jacobian is positive (task 0108)

gates.quantity: throat centreline velocity at peak flow (p2, $x = 0$)
gates.limit: within 5 % of the DNS, and above $3.65\,u_c$

gates.quantity: flow features of the paper's §3.1 (jet in acceleration, post-stenotic separation in late deceleration, upstream separation at $-1\,D$ and $-2\,D$, no permanent recirculation, laminar and axisymmetric)

notes: Inlet: eq. 2.1 of the paper (Womersley), as stated.  The database's own x = -2D profiles differ from it by up to 0.145 u_c at the phases their flow rates give, so the station-by-station profile RMS is reported, not gated (design answer to task 0068's Q1-Q2).
